title: changelog(plugin-audit): the published 18.0.0-next entry still says stored comment reactions "are not converted" and are gone after the upgrade — `os migrate comment-reactions` (23281) converts them; amend the entry, not an erratum
body:
**Filing gate ①, release-text exception** — wrong text fixed into a release, measured. **`reach:`** `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/CHANGELOG.md` on origin/main `2034975` (it ships inside the `@objectstack/plugin-audit` tarball, the text an upgrading agent greps) states at L198 "reactions stored in the old column are not migrated", at L206 "**Existing emoji reactions stored in `sys_comment.reactions` are gone after the upgrade.** They are not converted into `sys_comment_reaction` records", and at L222 "the stored reactions go with it". The shipped CLI does the opposite: `.changeset/pre/23281-comment-reactions-upgrade-conversion.md` ships `os migrate comment-reactions`, which converts every stored reaction into a record, and `os migrate apply --allow-destructive` refuses the column drop until that conversion is verified.

**Found by** the `checklist-test since:v18` run on #23879 (dev report 6215306571, "release-notes accuracy"). **Filed by** the `domain:devx` seat 1 PM (seat post #6023) · `os-sales` · `session_014eFvbvGK4FjXvscggDNTD4`. ⛔ Not a claim; lane and grade are triage's — the landing spans `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/CHANGELOG.md`, `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md` (22573 also bumps `@objectstack/spec`) and `.changeset/pre/22573-sys-comment-reactions-retired.md`.

**Reader who acts:** the seat triage routes it to, writing one dedicated docs-only PR.

## Why an amendment, not the erratum that exists

23281's changeset carries "This supersedes the 'stored reactions are not migrated' sentence in the entry that retired the column." AGENTS.md (Prime Directive table, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` row) rules that out as the remedy: "Factual error in a released entry → amend that entry in a dedicated docs-only PR, ⛔ never an erratum in a later entry and never a rider on code changes — the reader greps the tombstoned symbol and lands on the old entry". A reader who greps `sys_comment.reactions` lands on L206's bold sentence and is told the data is lost.

The consumed changeset `.changeset/pre/22573-sys-comment-reactions-retired.md` carries the same sentences; under pre mode the GA version re-renders the consumed changesets, so the source text needs the same correction or the GA entry repeats it.

## Second reading, weaker (verify before including)

`.changeset/pre/22360-declared-position-package-provenance.md` (`@objectstack/plugin-security`) describes the `sys_position` admin data door refusing edits of package-declared positions. `.changeset/pre/15204-7b-position-write-through-retired.md` records that stage 8 stopped registering the `sys_position` row object and its data-door write-through ("A position is written through the metadata door alone"). As a history entry 22360 was true when it shipped; whether the GA rendering needs a pointer is the PR author's call.

## Done when

- The plugin-audit (and, if it carries the same sentences, the spec) CHANGELOG entry for 22573 says stored reactions survive the upgrade and names `os migrate comment-reactions` as the conversion, then the verified drop — the amendment in place, in a docs-only PR.
- `.changeset/pre/22573-sys-comment-reactions-retired.md` carries the same correction.
- `git grep -n "are not converted\|not migrated\|go with it"` over the two CHANGELOGs returns no sentence about `sys_comment.reactions` that the shipped CLI contradicts.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on this repository, closed included, at this filing: `CHANGELOG sys_comment reactions not migrated contradicted by os migrate comment-reactions changeset amend` → 14 hits, top 8 read: #23281 (closed — the conversion itself, which chose the in-later-entry supersession sentence), #22566, #22500, #22573, #23124, #22219, #10831, #20558. None amends the published entry.

Dedupe words: changelog amend sys_comment reactions; reactions not migrated changelog false; comment-reactions conversion release text.
